# Release notes
## Mac and connected devices
- **New connection service for remote access:** Making this Mac reachable from your other devices now uses OpenTunnel instead of a Cloudflare tunnel. There is no helper to download, and the Mac handles the secure connection itself, so the relay only carries encrypted traffic. The first time you turn it on, the Mac requests a certificate, which takes about a minute. Update each Mac you host from; until it updates, your other devices won't see it. - **Smoother streaming replies:** Replies appear a whole word at a time and new text fades in, instead of showing half-finished words and raw formatting marks while an agent writes. - **Answer tool requests from anywhere:** When a tool asks for permission, Decline and Cancel now work from your iPhone as well as the Mac. - **Screenshots in replies open reliably:** Images an agent links to by a screenshot's file name now open even when the name was typed with an ordinary space before AM or PM. - **Faster remote chats:** When viewing another Mac, the chat list and pictures in replies are saved on this device, so they appear at once when you reconnect or revisit a conversation.

# Release notes
## Mac and connected devices
- **Better coordination between agents:** New conversations can see which other threads are working in the project, what they were last asked to do and whether they share a checkout, helping agents coordinate their work. - **More reliable notifications:** Improved notification handling and opening conversations from notifications on Mac, iPhone and iPad. - **Working chats stay up to date:** Remote conversations that are still working keep receiving updates when you switch to another chat, so their latest progress is ready when you return. - **Immediate feedback for remote actions:** Sent messages, queued prompts and answers to agent questions appear locally while the Mac processes them. If the host rejects a message, its text and attachments return to your draft. - **Images stay ready:** Attached images appear while uploading, and images already viewed or sent are cached on the device to avoid downloading them again when you revisit a conversation.
## ControllerMobile for iPhone and iPad
- **Smoother activity card:** The activity orb animates while work is running and expands into its card with a continuous glass transition. - **Native attachment menu:** The attachment button opens the system menu for choosing Photos or Files, making the choices more reliable to open from the composer.

# Release notes
## Mac and connected devices
- **Related threads stay together:** Threads started by an agent now appear beneath their parent conversation. Expand or collapse the group to follow delegated work without filling the sidebar or chat list. - **Less repeated agent context:** Agents can discover tools on demand, and unchanged browser and session instructions are no longer repeated on every prompt. Thread-management tools also return more concise results. - **More reliable image attachments:** Imported images now appear in the composer when loading finishes. - **Smoother interface:** Sidebar gestures, activity indicators, pending requests and composer controls transition more smoothly, with improved support for Reduce Motion.
## ControllerMobile for iPhone and iPad
- **Activity at a glance:** The conversation's activity orb brings together agents, background work, sources and repository status. Open its card or keep it pinned while you follow a chat. Files and Git are now in the conversation menu. - **Faster recent chats:** Recent conversation history is cached and preloaded, so reopening a chat can show its messages while the host refreshes agent state. - **Images from your Mac, inline:** Images and screenshots saved by agents on the host now appear directly in the conversation. - **Steadier streaming and scrolling:** Running work appears step by step, with a smoother transition to the finished reply. Loading earlier messages and following long replies better preserve your reading position. - **More comfortable composing:** Slash-command search keeps the keyboard open. Dictation and attachment loading keep the controls steady, with larger touch targets and clearer haptic feedback.
